messages:
viv-liu: Quick thread 00: can we iterate the battlecard to surface 'serving-first' vs cloud APIs + infra vendors? Focus: one believable latency stat, brief TCO callout, and a webinar hook.

priya-k: Uploaded a barebones draft: https://redwood.internal/mkt/bcards/serving-first-v1 (pls comment). Keep language evidence-first; include repro notes for any perf claim.

sam-g: Sales want a p99 soundbite for long convs. Jon, can you confirm p99 ratio we can cite for 2k tokens? If verifiable we can use: "~3x lower p99".

jon-eng: Short bench snippet: seq=2048 p99: Redwood=760ms, VendorY=2300ms. Measured on warm cache, 20k requests. Repro: `python bench/run.py --model redwood-opt --seq 2048 --requests 20000 --batch 8`. Use cautious wording and link the reproducibility note.

casey-sales: Good. Add one-liner for procurement: "Managed serving + rollout + observability reduces ops risk vs DIY GPUs". Also set inbound tag for leads mentioning "on-prem", "SLA", "dedicated" so SDRs route to AE.

meera-se: Webinar pitch: 12-min session: 4m quick econ slide (batching+caching), 6m live demo (failover + routing), 2m CTA. Title idea: "Keep LLM features online: economics, fallbacks, proof". Ops can schedule.

priya-k: I'll rework bullets: - Predictable unit cost (show delta slide) - Graceful fallback & routing (flowchart) - Observability + regression alerts (one-liner). I'll drop Jon's repro link into the appendix.

ops-bot: Webinar tentative: Thu 11am PT. Register by Tue COB to guarantee recording. :calendar:

viv-liu: Perfect. Next steps: Priya update battlecard + one-liner elevator; Jon paste bench methodology into doc; Casey add procurement TCO slide and SDR routing tags; Meera draft runbook. Target: ship updated deck + card by Thu EOD. Thanks all! :rocket:
